import networkx as nx
import itertools

g = nx.Graph()
g.add_nodes_from(range(15))
g.add_edges_from([(2,12), (3,10), (6,9), (3,13), (3,12), (0,13)])

for edges in itertools.combinations(itertools.combinations(range(15), 2), 20):
    g.add_edges_from(edges)
    if nx.girth(g) >= 4 and all(2 <= g.degree(v) <= 5 for v in g.nodes):
        print([(u, v) for u, v in g.edges if u < v])
        break
